title: The ts gate does not run cloudflare's contracts:test and operator-strings
description:
The ts gate now runs vitest (tc9), but the two node --test suites around cloudflare's scripts still run only in ci.yml's `pnpm test` step: contracts.test.mjs tests scripts/contracts.mjs — the check the gate itself runs — and operator-strings.test.mjs tests scripts/operator-strings.mjs. A tick that breaks the check script itself (the one class of change that can make contracts:check pass wrongly) or the operator-strings script settles with no gate evidence for it; CI catches it later, which is exactly the gate/CI split tc9 exists to close for the behaviour suite. Both suites are sub-second locally (measured 2026-10-07: 0.16s and 0.37s), so folding them into the ts command costs nothing measurable. The gap is named in .tick/runners.toml's ts comment. Same class as yoh finding dfae216d, one script level down.
evidence: cloudflare/package.json scripts (test, contracts:test, operator-strings); .github/workflows/ci.yml 'pnpm test' step; .tick/runners.toml [testing.commands] ts
